question: Give me a report for warehouse_safety_0001.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-report and routes to Mode A because the request names a video/sensor without incident wording or a time range. The agent resolves a VST clip URL through /vss-manage-video-io-storage, calls the selected VLM chat/completions endpoint with a video_url block, copies assets/video-analysis-report.md, replaces every placeholder including BROWSER_CLIP_URL, and never uses POST /generate.
expected_behavior: Routes to Mode A without asking the user to choose a mode.
Obtains a clip URL via /vss-manage-video-io-storage and rewrites only the report-facing URL to BROWSER_CLIP_URL.
Calls the resolved VLM chat/completions endpoint with text plus video_url content.
Returns a filled # Video Analysis Report from assets/video-analysis-report.md with no raw placeholders or template instructions.

question: Give me a report on incidents on warehouse_safety_0001 between 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z and 2025-01-01T01:00:00.000Z.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-report and routes to Mode B because the request asks for incidents in an explicit time range. The agent calls /vss-query-analytics with video_analytics__get_incidents, copies assets/incident-range-report.md, fills the incident summary from analytics data, rewrites any clip URLs before displaying them, and does not call the VLM or POST /generate.
expected_behavior: Routes to Mode B and calls video_analytics__get_incidents with the requested source and time range.
Does not call the VLM chat/completions endpoint for an incident-range report.
Returns a filled # Incident Range Report or a one-line no-incidents report when analytics returns zero results.
Omits incident clip lines when no rewritten browser-playable URL is available.

question: Report on incidents on warehouse_safety_0001 between 1900-01-01T00:00:00.000Z and 1900-01-01T01:00:00.000Z.
ground_truth: Loads vss-generate-video-report, routes to Mode B, calls video_analytics__get_incidents for the exact historical range, and if no incidents are returned responds with a concise one-line no-incidents report instead of inventing content or falling back to Mode A.
expected_behavior: Queries analytics with the exact requested source and time range.
Returns a one-line no-incidents report when the result set is empty.
Does not fall back to Mode A or call the VLM for an empty incident range.
